/bin/bash -c "curl -L -s https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/rapid-release/species/Trachypithecus_francoisi/GCA_009764315.1/ensembl/geneset/2020_05/Trachypithecus_francoisi-GCA_009764315.1-2020_05-cds.fa.gz | gzip -dc | python3 -c \"import sys; data=sys.stdin.read();
for rec in data.split('>')[1:]:
 header=rec.split('\\n',1)[0]; seq=''.join(rec.split('\\n',1)[1].split());
 if 'ENSTFRG00000021586' in header:
  print(seq[:300]); print(len(seq), seq[-10:]); break
\" > francois_first300.txt
python3 - <<'PY'
human=''
sem=''
fran=open('francois_first300.txt').read().strip().split('\\n')[0]
print(len(fran), len(sem), fran==sem)
import Levenshtein
print('fran-human',Levenshtein.distance(fran,human),'sem-human',Levenshtein.distance(sem,human))
PY"
